```{r}
#| label: setup
library(disasterMaps)

tzone <- "America/Los_Angeles"
cache_dir <- tempdir()
```

## Data




```{r}
#| label: load-data
#| warning: false
data_dir <- system.file("extdata", "fire", "population", package = "disasterMaps")
tiles_3857 <- load_population(data_dir, re_run = TRUE, cache_dir = cache_dir)

w <- compute_windows(tiles_3857, tzone)

lon_limits <- range(tiles_3857$longitude)
lat_limits <- range(tiles_3857$latitude)
zoom <- 10

map_bbox <- c(
  xmin = lon_limits[1], ymin = lat_limits[1],
  xmax = lon_limits[2], ymax = lat_limits[2]
)
```

## Population map




```{r}
#| label: population-map
p1 <- population_plot(
  plot_ds = w$latest_ds, plot_hour = w$latest_hour, tzone = tzone,
  lon_limits = lon_limits, lat_limits = lat_limits, zoom = zoom
)
p1
```

## Terrain




```{r}
#| label: terrain
terrain <- terrain_hillshade(map_bbox, zoom = 9, cache_dir = cache_dir)
terrain$elevation
head(terrain$shade_df)
```

## Rivers and roads




```{r}
#| label: rivers
rivers <- osm_lines_cached(
  map_bbox, key = "waterway", values = "river",
  tag = "water_major", cache_dir = cache_dir
)
rivers
```

```{r}
#| label: roads
roads <- osm_lines_cached(
  map_bbox, key = "highway",
  values = c("motorway", "motorway_link", "trunk", "trunk_link",
             "primary", "primary_link"),
  tag = "roads_major", cache_dir = cache_dir
)
roads
```

## State borders




```{r}
#| label: state-borders
borders <- state_borders(map_bbox)
borders
```

## City labels




```{r}
#| label: cities
cities <- data.frame(
  place = "Map centre",
  lon = mean(lon_limits),
  lat = mean(lat_limits)
)

city_label_layers(p1, cities)
```

## All layers




```{r}
#| label: add-map-layers
add_map_layers(
  p1, map_bbox, osm = TRUE, pop_sf = tiles_3857,
  config = list(
    cache_dir = cache_dir,
    rivers = "major",
    roads = "major",
    show_state_borders = TRUE,
    cities = cities
  )
)
```

## Disaster layers




```{r}
#| label: hooks
add_map_layers(
  p1, map_bbox, osm = TRUE, pop_sf = tiles_3857,
  config = list(cache_dir = cache_dir, cities = cities),
  over_pop = function(p) {
    p + ggplot2::geom_sf(
      data = fetch_fires(
        start_date = as.Date(w$first_ds) - 1,
        end_date = as.Date(w$latest_ds) + 1,
        lon_limits = lon_limits, lat_limits = lat_limits,
        re_run = TRUE, cache_dir = cache_dir
      ),
      colour = "orange", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    )
  }
)
```
